_correction_2026_08_09: P2-REVISIT. Every thermal claim in this file was written assuming U1 has an EXPOSED THERMAL PAD with a 3x3 via array under it. reports/u1-land-ruling.md refuted that with vendor evidence: AP63356QZV-7 (V-DFN3020-13/SWP Type A1) has 9 LANDS AND NO EXPOSED PAD, and the heat exits are the VIN LAND and the GND LAND (DS41948 p.25 rules 7-8, Figure 47). Corrected here: _headline[0], thermal_constraints, _constraint_rationale, part_class.regulator, rails[2].regulator, stackup_recommendation.why, layout_notes[3], open[2]. Superseded text is retained inline with a 'SUPERSEDED:' marker so the removed assumption stays visible. Full recomputation: reports/thermal-recheck.md. Gate numbers did NOT move (check_thermal never modelled an EP); the LAYOUT PRESCRIPTION and the 4L rationale did.
_note: P1 power-architect output for buck-5v3a. This board IS the power conversion stage, so the 'rail tree' is one converted rail; the engineering content is the loss/thermal budget in research/power.md. Net names are CONVENTIONAL - re-key every entry against the P4 netlist before merging into constraints.json. thermal_constraints[].ref is a PROPOSAL (check_thermal exits 2 on a refdes with no pads): re-key or delete at P3/P5. Extra keys (stackup_recommendation, layout_notes, planes_hint, part_class) are carried outside the agreed shape because power.json has no slot for them; P2 owns whether they land in constraints.json or architecture/.
_headline: CORRECTED 2026-08-09: 4 LAYERS ARE KEPT, BUT NOT FOR THERMAL REASONS. Worst corner is still LOW LINE (7 V in, 3 A, 50 C ambient, natural convection): high duty puts the loss in the high-side FET. With the real part (AP63356QZV-7, 74/40 mohm typ, P_IC 0.881 W) the P8 gate gives theta_JA 51.1 C/W and T_j 95.0 C on 4L against 73.8 C/W and 115.1 C on 2L - but a first-principles recomputation (reports/thermal-recheck.md s3) puts the REAL 4L-vs-2L gap at only ~3.3 C/W (~3 C of junction temperature), because with 2 oz outers the 0.5 oz inner planes add just 18 % more lateral copper. Four layers now stand on the UNBROKEN In1 GND RETURN PLANE under the Cin->VIN->GND hot loop (buck.md s3, DS41948 layout rule 6) and on the gate, not on T_j. Best physical estimate of theta_JA on this board is ~36 C/W (32-41 over h = 20-40 W/m2K); the datasheet's 25 C/W is correct for its own JEDEC-class board and unreachable at 2000 mm2. SUPERSEDED: '4-LAYER IS REQUIRED, and the number that decides it is the regulator's junction temperature ... Best-in-class part (45/20 mohm) -> T_j ~ 90 C on 4L vs ~109 C on 2L; a mainstream 3 A-class part (95/66 mohm) -> ~122 C on 4L and ~153 C on 2L ... 4L + low-RDS(on) is the only combination with real margin.' (the <= 90 mohm filter was deleted at P2 for rejecting the whole real shortlist).

The part CLASS is a thermal decision, not a cost decision: RDS(on)_HS + RDS(on)_LS <= 90 mohm typ at 25 C is the selection filter. It is worth ~0.5 W and ~30 C of junction temperature versus the 95/66 mohm mainstream 3 A parts.

Total board loss 1.20 W at 7 V / 1.03 W at 12 V / 1.03 W at 18 V -> efficiency 92.6 / 93.6 / 93.6 %. Input power 16.0-16.2 W; input current 2.31 A worst case (7 V). Copper and screw-terminal contact resistance is 0.09-0.13 W of that - not noise on a 1 W budget.

Input capacitor RMS ripple peaks at 1.51 A at Vin = 10 V - INSIDE the 7-18 V window, not at either end (I_rms maximises at D = 0.5). Size Cin for 1.5 A RMS at 500 kHz and 100 C, i.e. X7R only - X5R (85 C) is disqualified by the board's own ~90 C hotspot.

Output ripple is a non-problem: 2-3 x 22 uF X7R gives ~10 mV pk-pk against the 50 mV budget. The binding output-cap question is the LOAD TRANSIENT of an unknown external load, not ripple (see open[0]).

The 4 A input fuse (A5) is thermally marginal: SMD fuses derate to ~70 % of rating at 85-95 C local board temperature -> 2.8 A effective against a 2.31 A worst-case operating current (21 % margin). Recommend 5 A time-lag, or place the fuse in the coolest corner and accept the margin. See open[1].

Reverse-polarity P-FET must be specified at Vgs = -4.5 V, not -10 V: at the 7 V low-line corner the gate only has 7 V to work with. RDS(on) <= 15 mohm at Vgs = -4.5 V gives 80 mW at 2.31 A, inside A4's 100 mW target.

rails.vin: J1 2-pin 5.08 mm screw terminal, 7-18 V DC, 12 V nominal. Source is a bench supply or AC-DC adapter (A1) - not a battery, not automotive, so no load-dump campaign and no -40 C rating.

consumers.basis: Iin = Pin / Vin. Pin = 15 W out + modelled losses = 16.20 W at 7 V, 16.03 W at 12 V, 16.03 W at 18 V (loss model in power.md s3). 16.20/7 = 2.31 A worst case; 16.03/12 = 1.34 A nominal; 16.03/18 = 0.89 A at high line.

rails.notes: Raw, unprotected stub: J1 pin 1 -> F1 (fuse) -> Q1 (P-FET) source. /VIN_F is the same net electrically between F1 and Q1 and carries the same budget. Series loss at the 7 V corner: F1 0.118 W (22 mohm class) + Q1 0.080 W (15 mohm at Vgs = -4.5 V). current_a 3.0 A is the design ceiling: it covers the 2.31 A operating worst case AND makes the copper survive the fuse's non-blow current (1.80 mm at 1 oz outer carries 4 A at ~19 C rise). pdn false - nothing decouples a pre-protection stub by design.

rails.vin: /VIN through F1 and Q1 (reverse-polarity P-FET drain)

consumers.basis: same DC budget as /VIN. The RMS current in the Cin -> VIN -> GND loop is Io*sqrt(D) = 3*sqrt(0.714) = 2.54 A at the 7 V corner - covered by the 3.0 A ceiling.
LMR33630 SNVSAN3F Electrical Characteristics: IQ 24 uA typ / 34 uA max, non-switching, measured at VIN. Class-typical; AP64500 quotes 25 uA in PFM.

rails.notes: Protected input rail: Q1 drain, TVS, Cin bank (2 x 10 uF 50 V X7R + 100 nF at the VIN pin), U1 VIN, optional EN/UVLO divider. Dissipation shown is Cin ESR loss only (1.51 A RMS worst case x ~4 mohm bank ESR). This is the hot-loop node: Cin -> VIN -> GND -> Cin is the shortest loop on the board (buck.md s3).

rails.regulator: SUPERSEDED - the part is AP63356QZV-7 (V-DFN3020-13/SWP, 9 lands, NO exposed pad, 74/40 mohm typ). Original class text, with its two dead filters marked: integrated-FET SYNCHRONOUS buck, VIN abs max >= 40 V, >= 4 A rated (5 A preferred), [DEAD] RDS(on)_HS + RDS(on)_LS <= 90 mohm typ at 25 C, fsw 400-600 kHz, [DEAD 2026-08-09] exposed-pad package (SO-8EP / HSOIC-8 PowerPAD / EP-QFN), internal soft-start, hiccup current limit + thermal shutdown, FIXED 5 V option preferred over adjustable. Exemplars for the loss model only: AP64500 (Diodes, 40 V, 5 A, SO-8EP, 45/20 mohm) and LMR33630 (TI, 36 V, 3 A, HSOIC-8, 95/66 mohm).

consumers.part: external load on the output screw terminal
consumers.basis: STATED (requirements s3) and bounded by A2: 3 A is the absolute maximum, no peak allowance above it. This is the only real consumer - the board is a converter, not a board with a power section.

A6 requires one green LED on +5V. (5.0 - 3.1 V Vf) / 1 kohm = 1.9 mA typ; 470 ohm would give 4.0 mA. 1 kohm recommended - the LED adds heat to an already hot board and 1.9 mA is plainly visible on a modern green part.
A6. Pads on the pour, no current.
~50 kohm string = 0.1 mA. Zero if a FIXED 5 V part is used - which is the recommendation, see notes.

rails.notes: Budget: 3.002 A of consumers; current_a 3.5 A is the design ceiling = peak inductor current at the 18 V corner (3.0 + 1.06/2 = 3.53 A), which is the current the L -> Cout -> J2 copper actually carries. dissipation_w is the REGULATOR's own loss at the worst (7 V) corner, not the rail's. Accuracy: A3 wants +/-3 % DC. A fixed-output class part meets that alone (LMR33630 SNVSAN3F System Characteristics: -1.5 %/+1.5 % for Vout = 5 V over 7-36 V, 1 A to max load). An ADJUSTABLE part adds divider tolerance to a +/-1.5 % reference -> use 0.5 % resistors or the window closes. buck.md s4 FB trap applies: fixed variants tie FB to the output sense point - do NOT copy the adjustable figure's divider.

_constraint_rationale.U1_power_w: CORRECTED 2026-08-09 to match architecture/constraints.json, which is the live copy. 0.881 W modelled at the 7 V worst corner for the REAL part (AP63356QZV-7, RDS(on) 92/48 mohm at ~105 C, from DS41948 p.5 typ 74/40 at 25 C), + ~8 % for the unpublished tr/tf and part-to-part RDS(on) spread = 0.95 W. DS41948 publishes NO maximum RDS(on) - that is the risk this margin covers. At 1.3x typ RDS(on), P_IC is ~1.10 W -> 56.2 C rise -> T_j ~106 C: still 44 C under the part's 150 C recommended max, but it trips this gate at dt_c 55, which is the intended sensitivity. SUPERSEDED: '0.63 W modelled ... for the recommended 45/20 mohm class, + ~27 % ... = 0.8 W'.
_constraint_rationale.U1_dt_c: 55 C allowed rise = the SOFT 105 C junction target (requirements s3) at 50 C ambient (A9). H1-d ruled 105 C soft, not a filter: the BINDING limit is the part's own TJ 150 C recommended operating max (dt_c 100) / 170 C absolute (dt_c 120). 55 is kept because it is the design target, it is met with 6.4 C of margin at 0.95 W, and it is the only machine-visible thermal discipline on this board. WITHDRAWN 2026-08-09: the claim that this value 'encodes the stackup decision'. A 2-layer build does fail the gate (73.8 C/W -> 70.2 C rise), but the real 4L-vs-2L junction-temperature gap is ~3 C, not ~20 C (reports/thermal-recheck.md s6), so dt_c 55 is a thermal target, not a layer-count enforcer.
_constraint_rationale.U1_min_vias: CORRECTED 2026-08-09 - THERE IS NO EXPOSED PAD. 12 GND vias, 0.55 mm pad / 0.30 mm drill, through (F.Cu->B.Cu), placed IN THE TOP GND POUR IMMEDIATELY AROUND THE GND LAND (pad 8, 1.500 x 0.750 mm): >= 8 within 2.0 mm of the land edge, all 12 within 4.0 mm of the U1 centroid, ~1.0 mm pitch. NOT via-in-pad (2 in-pad vias are worth ~0.2 C/W and would put open holes in the part's only thermal/mechanical joint; allowed only with JLC POFV resin-plug-and-cap ordered at P10). NOT the 0.45/0.20 rule-class minimum: a 0.30 barrel is 50.9 C/W to In1 vs 79.9 C/W for a 0.20 barrel. check_thermal does not raise its via warning at this power/dt (need_vias false at dt/power = 57.9 > 51.1), and it returns the IDENTICAL result on a board stripped of every via and the whole top pour - so this floor is enforced by P6/P7 review only. SUPERSEDED: 'a 3x3 array of 0.3 mm vias at 1.0 mm pitch inside the exposed-pad land plus >= 3 in the surrounding top-side GND pour'.
_constraint_rationale.U1_vin_land: ADDED 2026-08-09. The VIN land (pad 1) is the SECOND heat exit (DS41948 p.25 rule 8) and it gets NO vias, because this board has no VIN plane - rule 6 puts GND on In1 and In2, and that outranks rule 8 on a single-rail converter - and because +VIN must stay via-free for check_current's net-wide via rule. Its substitute is AREA: >= 60 mm2 of contiguous F.Cu +VIN pour joined to the VIN land, sitting over unbroken In1 GND (0.4284 mm of 7628x2 prepreg -> ~18-20 C/W of dielectric coupling at 60-80 mm2). The Cin bank plus the Q1 drain supply this naturally; the instruction is to POUR it, not route it.
_constraint_rationale.SW_dt_c: 20 C rather than 10 C: /SW is a deliberately SHORT node (buck.md s5 containment) and 3.5 A at dT 20 needs 1.51 mm instead of 2.23 mm. Keeps the switch-node polygon small without under-sizing it.
_constraint_rationale.GND_plane_fed: GND is declared explicitly rather than left to check_current's derived-return synthesis (which downgrades everything to advisory): on a 15 W converter the return path deserves ERROR-class pour-neck checking at the full 3.5 A.

part_class.regulator: SUPERSEDED at P2 (part chosen: AP63356QZV-7) and CORRECTED 2026-08-09. Class as originally written: 'integrated-FET synchronous buck; VIN abs max >= 40 V; Iout >= 4 A (5 A preferred); RDS(on)_HS + RDS(on)_LS <= 90 mohm typ at 25 C; fsw 400-600 kHz; EXPOSED-PAD PACKAGE; internal soft-start; hiccup-mode current limit + thermal shutdown; fixed 5 V output preferred. Reject: asynchronous parts, MHz-class parts, PACKAGES WITHOUT AN EXPOSED PAD.' TWO OF THOSE FILTERS ARE WRONG AND WERE DELETED: (1) the <= 90 mohm RDS(on) filter, deleted at P2 because it rejected the entire real shortlist; (2) the exposed-pad requirement, deleted 2026-08-09 because it would reject the chosen part - the AP63356QZV-7's V-DFN3020-13/SWP has 9 lands and NO exposed pad, and the vendor still measures theta_JA 25 C/W on that pattern (theta_JC 5 C/W die-to-land). What actually matters is a low theta_JC and large VIN/GND lands, not a belly pad.
part_class.inductor: shielded composite/moulded power inductor, 6.8 uH +/-20 %, Isat >= 6 A (must beat the class 4.5-5.5 A peak current limit, not the 3 A load - buck.md s2), DCR <= 25 mohm, 7x7 to 10x10 mm, rated 125 C.
part_class.cin: 2 x 10 uF 50 V X7R 1210 + 100 nF 50 V 0603 at the VIN pin. 50 V rating is required twice over: DC-bias derating (a 25 V part loses ~50 % at 12 V) and the hot-plug ring. >= 1.5 A RMS at 500 kHz. NOT X5R (85 C max vs a ~90 C board hotspot).
part_class.cout: 2-3 x 22 uF 25 V X7R 1210 (~15-17 uF each after 5 V DC bias). Confirm against the chosen part's stated C/ESR stability window (buck.md s4). Optional 100 uF polymer at J2 if the load steps - see open[0].
part_class.rpp_fet: P-channel MOSFET, Vds >= -40 V, Vgs(max) >= -20 V, RDS(on) <= 15 mohm AT Vgs = -4.5 V, Id >= 6 A, exposed-pad SO-8 / DFN. Gate network: 100 kohm to GND-side + 12-15 V zener clamp (protects Vgs at 18 V in); optional 10-100 nF gate cap for hot-plug soft-start.
part_class.fuse: SMD time-lag (slow-blow) fuse, 4 A per A5 or 5 A recommended (see open[1]), >= 50 V rating, cold resistance <= 25 mohm, 1206/1812.
part_class.tvs: unidirectional TVS on +VIN (AFTER the P-FET so a reverse connection does not short it): standoff 20-24 V, clamping voltage <= 33 V at 10 A, SMB/SMA.

stackup_recommendation.copper: SUPERSEDED at P2 -> 2 oz OUTER / 0.5 oz inner (JLC04162H-7628A, 1.6 mm). Original: '1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner'. The 2 oz outer is now the single most important copper decision on the board: with 0.5 oz inners the outer layers are 82 % of the lateral spreading, and F.Cu is the layer the die actually touches (no exposed pad, so the VIN/GND lands ARE the thermal interface).

assignment.F.Cu: components (top-side SMT only per A11), the hot loop, /SW polygon, +5V output pour, GND pours
assignment.In1.Cu: solid GND - unbroken under U1 and the entire Cin/VIN/GND hot loop; this is both the return plane and the primary heat spreader
assignment.In2.Cu: GND again (NOT +5V). +5V travels ~15 mm on F.Cu and needs no plane; a second GND plane is worth more as thermal mass and it is what DS41948 layout rule 6 asks for by name ('use at least the 2nd and 3rd layers as GND'). CORRECTED 2026-08-09: the old reason - 'lets the EP via array see copper on both inner layers' - is void, there is no EP via array; the GND-land via field is what sees both inner layers
assignment.B.Cu: GND pour, kept clear of SMT parts (A11), used as the bottom heat-radiating surface

stackup_recommendation.why: CORRECTED 2026-08-09. The old two-mechanism argument is withdrawn: (1) 'the EP thermal-via array only has to reach In1 ... 2.4 C/W for 9 vs 19.6 C/W' assumed an exposed pad that does not exist, and it compared a via bundle against nothing - the 2 oz top pour couples into In1 through 0.4284 mm of prepreg over its WHOLE area in parallel with the vias, so the real worth of 12 GND vias is ~5 C/W, not ~17; (2) 'two full-area inner planes roughly double the spreading area' is false at 0.5 oz - they add 0.030 mm of copper against 0.140 mm on the 2 oz outers, i.e. 18 % more lateral sheet conductance, and the 50x40 board is near-isothermal at two layers already. Recomputed 4L-vs-2L gap: ~3.3 C/W (~3 C of T_j), not the model's 23 C/W - check_thermal's MODEL_2L is a 1 oz calibration applied to a 2 oz board and its only 4L input is a boolean. FOUR LAYERS ARE STILL CORRECT, for reasons the refutation does not touch: the solid unbroken In1 GND return directly under the Cin->VIN->GND loop of a 450 kHz / 3.6 A-peak converter (buck.md s3; DS41948 rule 6 names GND on layers 2 and 3), plus the fact that a 2-layer build fails check_thermal by construction. Cost at qty 5 inside the 100x100 promo tier is a few dollars. See power.md s4.3 and reports/thermal-recheck.md s6.

layout_notes: HOT LOOP FIRST (buck.md s3): Cin (both 10 uF + the 100 nF) on the same layer as U1, VIN pad to GND pad loop as short as physically possible, In1 GND solid directly beneath it. This outranks every other placement preference on this board.

/SW: F.Cu only, ZERO vias, >= 1.51 mm wide, area as small as the 3.5 A width allows. check_current's via rule is net-wide (LEARNINGS 2026-07-28): one via on /SW would demand ceil(3.5/0.5) = 7 vias in that cluster.

+5V: F.Cu pour from L1 / Cout to J2, ZERO vias, >= 2.23 mm equivalent width. The pd-trigger recipe applies - a via-free pour is also exempt from check_current's pour-neck test (necks are only measured between via attachments).

U1 HAS NO EXPOSED PAD (CORRECTED 2026-08-09; superseded text was 'U1 exposed pad: land >= EP size, 3x3 array of 0.3 mm vias at 1.0 mm pitch (tented on B.Cu; via-in-pad epoxy fill is NOT required at this power level), >= 200 mm2 of contiguous F.Cu GND pour joined to the land, >= 12 GND vias within 4 mm of the part.'). The two heat exits are the GND LAND (pad 8) and the VIN LAND (pad 1), each 1.500 x 0.750 mm. GND side: >= 12 vias of 0.55 mm pad / 0.30 mm drill, through F.Cu->B.Cu, in the top GND pour AROUND the land - >= 8 within 2.0 mm of the land edge, all 12 within 4.0 mm of the U1 centroid, ~1.0 mm pitch (never below 0.85 mm: 0.55 pads at 0.1016 clearance need 0.65 mm and the pour must stay connected). NO via-in-pad unless JLC POFV resin-plug-and-cap is ordered - worth ~0.2 C/W and it puts open holes in the part's only thermal/mechanical joint. Vias tented on B.Cu. VIN side: ZERO vias (no VIN plane, and +VIN is via-free for check_current), substituted by >= 60 mm2 of contiguous F.Cu +VIN pour joined to the VIN land over unbroken In1 GND. Plus >= 200 mm2 of contiguous F.Cu GND pour joined to the GND land, and In1/In2 solid GND with no split within 6 mm of the U1 centroid. NOTE: no gate tests any of this - check_thermal returns the identical result on a board with zero vias and no top pour (machine-verified), so P6/P7 review is the only enforcement.
Thermal separation: keep L1 (0.24-0.28 W) >= 5 mm from U1 so the two hot spots do not stack; keep the fuse F1 in the coolest corner near J1 (its rating derates ~30 % at 90 C board temperature).
No aluminium electrolytic anywhere on this board: a 105 C part at a ~90 C board temperature has ~5.7 kh of life. Cin/Cout are all-ceramic X7R; if bulk is added for the load transient, use polymer.

P6/P7 must add check_current overrides once placement exists: the D1 LED tap on +5V ({"radius_mm": 6, "current_a": 0.05}) and any thin test-point stub, otherwise every 0.25 mm branch reads as an undersized 3.5 A track.
Leave a footprint pair for an optional input CM/pi filter (A7) between J1 and F1 - unpopulated by default.
J1 and J2 on opposite edges, wire entry facing outward, silk-labelled VIN 7-18V and 5V 3A; A8 four M3 holes inset from the corners of the 50 x 40 outline.
open: LOAD TRANSIENT: what does the external load do? Ripple is met with margin (10 mV of a 50 mV budget) but a 0 -> 3 A step against 40 uF effective output capacitance and a ~40 kHz loop dips the rail ~300 mV (6 %), outside A3's +/-3 % window if that window is meant to hold dynamically. Cheap hedge: one 100 uF polymer at J2. Confirm the step size/rate, or accept the +/-3 % window as a DC/line-load-regulation spec only (which is how it is written).

FUSE RATING: A5 fixes ~4 A. At the 85-95 C local board temperature a 4 A SMD fuse derates to ~2.8 A against a 2.31 A worst-case operating current - 21 % margin, which risks nuisance opening at the 7 V corner. Recommend 5 A time-lag instead (the regulator's hiccup limit, not the fuse, is what protects the output). Needs an explicit yes/no because it relaxes a binding answer.

CLOSED by H1-d (2026-08-08) and by the 2026-08-09 recheck. JUNCTION-TEMPERATURE CEILING: 105 C is a SOFT design target, NOT a part-selection filter; the binding limit is the part's own maximum (TJ 150 C recommended operating, 170 C absolute, TSD 170 C typ). The chosen AP63356QZV-7 lands at T_j 95.0 C at the 7 V corner on 4 layers (gate), 89-101 C by first-principles including neighbour heating - 55 C under the recommended max. The <= 90 mohm RDS(on) filter this item defended was deleted at P2. See reports/thermal-recheck.md s5 and s7.

h (combined natural convection + radiation) is the widest remaining uncertainty in the thermal case, not the copper: 20 vs 40 W/m2K moves the first-principles theta_JA from 40.8 to 28.3 C/W. No verdict turns on it - every case clears the part's limits - but no claim tighter than 'T_j is 79-101 C at the 7 V corner' is supportable before bench measurement. DS41948 publishes no psi_JT, so the usual T_j = T_top + psi_JT x P recipe cannot be run as written; use a case-top thermocouple plus theta_JC = 5 C/W as an upper bound on the die-to-case delta (+4.4 C at 0.881 W).

architecture/stackup.md s2.3 and s2.4 still carry the exposed-pad story (the EP via-array depth argument, the +10 C neighbour allowance, and 'the 2-layer option is closed' on thermal grounds). They are superseded by reports/thermal-recheck.md s3/s6 but were NOT edited by the P1 recheck - stackup.md is P2 architecture and rewriting it is the architect's call. Its conclusion (4L, 2 oz outer, JLC04162H-7628A) is unchanged and correct.
